# DSH Sidebar Video Player
English | 简体中文

A video player that lives in the **right Sidebar** of DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`), with live
playback t
elemetry and a small, read-only MP4/MOV container reader.

Open it once and you can play a local video beside the conversation while reading its
resolution, ex

act frame count, average frame rate, per-track bitrate, codec profile/level,
buffer health and dropp
ed frames — numbers a plain `<video>` element does not expose.
## Install

If the package is later published to npm, the same profile can install it by name:

Restart or reload the Web UI after installing. The plugin appears as an enabled bundle
row named `ds
h-sidebar-video-player`.
## Open it

- Right Sidebar → **Start** (the guide) → **Video player**.
- Or click the video icon beside Setting
s at the left Sidebar foot.

The player is a right-Sidebar tab. It needs an open Session, because the right column
is session-sco
ped; the footer icon is disabled while no Session is on screen.
## Features

- Play a local video by picker or drag-and-drop, or load an HTTP(S) video URL.
- **Folder playlist**

: choose a folder and every video inside it is listed in a column to
the right of the player. Each c

ard shows a **first-frame thumbnail** and a duration
badge; click an item to switch. The active item

is highlighted, and the next item starts
automatically when one ends.
- **Sorting**: order the play

list by name, duration, modified time or size, ascending or
descending.
- **Fullscreen**: a header c

ontrol and the existing transport button both toggle the player
fullscreen; `F` does the same. Fulls

creen hides the stats and playlist and keeps the
transport controls.
- **Playlist context menu**: ri

ght-click a card for Rename, Copy file, Copy relative path,
Delete local file and Refresh. File acti

ons use the browser File System Access API and
require choosing the folder through the directory pic

ker with write access; the read-only
folder-input fallback disables them.
- Custom transport: play/p

ause, seek, volume, mute, playback rate, picture-in-picture,
fullscreen.
- Keyboard shortcuts while

the player has focus: `Space` / `K`, `J` / `L`, arrow keys,
`M`, `F`.
- Live playback telemetry:
- c

urrent time, duration, progress, buffered range and buffer ahead;
- measured decoded FPS from `reque

inspection without decoding media:
- container: major/compatible brands, timescale, duration, `moov`

splay size, aspect ratio,
rotation, exact frame count, average FPS, per-track bitrate, bit depth, du

decodable containers (WebM, Ogg, …) still play and report measured
resolution, FPS and frame counter

s. Container-level inspection is MP4/MOV only.
- A collapsible **Raw probe data** panel shows the ex

act parsed JSON.
- English and Simplified Chinese copy, using the host theme tokens.
## How the MP4/MOV reader works

The reader never loads a whole file into memory. It walks top-level ISO-BMFF boxes with
`Blob.slice`
, reads `moov` once (capped at 64 MiB), and extracts:

- `mvhd` for the movie timescale/duration;
- each `trak` → `tkhd` (display size, rotation), `mdhd` (

track timescale/duration,
language), `hdlr` (video/audio handler), `stsd` (sample entry, codec fourc

c,
`avcC`/`hvcC`/`av1C`, `esds`), `stts` (sample count and timing) and `stsz`
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.3 <0.3.0-0`; built and tested against the Web client.
- Requires a browse

r that can decode the chosen container/codec. MP4/H.264/AAC is the
safest choice; HEVC/AV1 support d

epends on the browser.
- The player is a view surface for playback and inspection. It registers no a

gent tool and
writes no Session events. File writes use the browser File System Access API only afte

r
you choose a folder with write permission; the plugin does not request Host file-system
authority.

- File operations (rename/copy/delete) require a Chromium-based browser or Electron and a
folder ch

osen through the directory picker. The fallback `<input webkitdirectory>` path
is read-only, so its
context-menu file actions are disabled.
## Permissions and privacy

- A selected local file is read through a browser Blob URL; it is not uploaded.
- Choosing a folder

with write access lets the browser rename, copy or delete files in
that folder when you pick a conte

xt-menu action. Nothing is written without an explicit
action and the browser's permission prompt.
-

A remote URL is fetched by the browser only for playback. The plugin does not proxy
remote media or

read remote container metadata.
- No analytics, telemetry, external service, or credentials are use

d.
- The only Host-side surface is the plugin bundle row; all player state stays in the
Web page.
## Known limitations

- Deep container parsing covers `.mp4`, `.m4v` and `.mov`. Other formats are played but
only expose

what the browser reports.
- Remote video is not container-probed (cross-origin reads are not assumed

e is an average over the track, not a live network bitrate.
- The right Sidebar is session-scoped; t

here is no player without an open Session.
- File operations require Chromium/Electron and a folder

chosen with write permission; the
fallback folder input is read-only.
- Copy duplicates the file ins

ide the same folder; it is not a system clipboard file copy.
- There is no "Reveal in Explorer" acti

on; the browser sandbox does not expose the OS file
manager.
- Delete and rename change the local fi
le immediately after confirmation; there is no undo.
